description: This file defines the EntityUser class, a Drupal migration destination plugin for migrating user entities, including handling password hashing and user data processing.

classes.name: EntityUser
classes.description: A Drupal migration destination plugin class for migrating user entities, handling password processing and user data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityUser plugin with necessary services and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the EntityUser class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports a row of user data, with special handling to prevent overwriting the root user password.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the user entity, handling password hashing and special cases for the root user.

methods.description: Processes a stub row to generate unique username and email if missing.

methods.name: getHighestId
methods.description: Retrieves the highest user ID, ensuring the root user ID remains consistent.
